title: QS I-GAUGE
content:
[vc_row][vc_column][smartslider3 slider="31"][vc_empty_space height="25"][vc_column_text]ATME College of Engineering is rated ‘GOLD’ by QS I·GAUGE for its Overall Excellence as a top-notch College. As one of the best rated College in Mysuru, ATME College of Engineering has been excelling in the field of education for more than 10 years.

ATME is proud to receive QS I·GAUGE ‘GOLD’ rating for its overall excellence and has become the 1<sup>st</sup> College in Mysuru to be awarded in Engineering Category.

While the entire nation is trapped under the threat of corona virus pandemic, ATME College is striving constantly to maintain a global benchmark in imparting first-rate education. Through an overabundance of its unique programs, the college is helping students leverage the most out of their degrees, I·GAUGE is a brand incorporated in India as an independent private-sector initiative specialized in rating colleges and universities. It brings together the global expertise, experience, and reputation of United Kingdom (UK) based Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), along with deep local knowledge of luminaries from Indian Higher Education. Based on the globally recognized QS STARS University Rating System developed by QS, QS I·GAUGE has been adapted to capture the reality of the dynamic Indian higher education sector, while at the same time maintaining the strict quality standards that are synonymous with the QS brand.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
